minutes_text:
CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS
  455 North Rexford Drive
  Beverly Hills, CA 90210
  Video Teleconference
  Beverly Hills City Council Liaison / Rodeo Drive/Special Events/Holiday Program
  Committee Meeting

  SPECIAL MEETING HIGHLIGHTS

  Thursday, February 29, 2024
  4:00 PM

MEETING CALLED TO ORDER
Date / Time:  February 29, 2024 / 4:00 PM
IN ATTENDANCE:  Vice Mayor Lester Friedman, Councilmember Lili Bosse, Deputy City
  Manager Keith Sterling, Community Outreach Manager Magdalena Davis

  1) Public Comment:

  None

  2) Request for Funding and Street Closures of the 2024 Rodeo Drive Concours
  d’Elegance Father’s Day Car Show on Sunday, June 16, 2024:
  a. Last year’s event saw more than 44,000 people in attendance.
  b. O’Gara Coach will be the title sponsor for this year's Car Show.
  c. The event is highly publicized, with last year seeing on air coverage in 43
  standalone news segments, 98 articles, and 226 million total media impressions.
  d. The RDC presented 2 banner options to the Liaisons, with the first in green and
  the second in maroon.
  e. Street closures would run from Saturday, June 15 at 5:00 PM to Sunday June 16
  at 11:00 PM.
  f. The streets closed would be Rodeo Drive between Little Santa Monica and
  Wilshire as well as the blocks of Brighton Way and Dayton Way that intersect with
  Rodeo.
  g. The Beverly Hills Chamber of Commerce will promote the event in a number of
  ways, such as social media, newsletters, and outreach to companies such as
  Gucci Osteria, 208 Rodeo, The Blvd, and the Hideaway to confirm hours and
  dining reservation options during Father’s Day weekend.
  h. There is an error in the packets and presentation that last year’s sponsorships
  were worth $250,000. They were actually worth $282,500.
  i. The City base funding request for the 2024 Concours d’Elegance is $298,450.
  j. Councilmember Bosse preferred the maroon option for the banners.
  k. The RDC preferred the maroon option as well.
  l. Vice Mayor Friedman preferred the maroon option as well, with the caveat that the
  palm trees in the background can be highlighted so they are visible, which
  Councilmember Bosse agreed with.
  m. Both Liaisons approve of the budget for the event and the street closures.
 Highlights for February 29, 2024
Rodeo Drive/Special Events/Holiday Program Committee

  3) Future Agenda Items:
  a. Item number two will be brought to a study session on March 11th.

  4) Adjournment:
  Date / Time: January 31, 2024 / 4:15 PM
